bug_fixed.issue: Tally XML generation failed with 'tuple object has no attribute split' error
bug_fixed.root_cause: The expression `(invoice.get('billing_address') or customer.get('address') or '',).split('\n')` was creating a tuple due to the trailing comma before the closing parenthesis, then calling .split() on the tuple instead of the string
bug_fixed.fix: Extracted the address to a variable first: `addr_source = invoice.get('billing_address') or customer.get('address') or ''` then `for raw in addr_source.split('\n'):`
